variables.name: UNSET
variables.comment: A clipping configuration with default values.

variables.name: startPositionMs
variables.comment: The start position in milliseconds. This is a value larger than or equal to zero.

variables.name: endPositionMs
variables.comment:
* The end position in milliseconds. This is a value larger than or equal to zero or {@link
     * C#TIME_END_OF_SOURCE} to play to the end of the stream.

variables.name: relativeToLiveWindow
variables.comment:
* Whether the clipping of active media periods moves with a live window. If {@code false},
     * playback ends when it reaches {@link #endPositionMs}.

variables.name: relativeToDefaultPosition
variables.comment:
* Whether {@link #startPositionMs} and {@link #endPositionMs} are relative to the default
     * position.

variables.name: startsAtKeyFrame
variables.comment: Sets whether the start point is guaranteed to be a key frame.

variables.name: CREATOR
variables.comment: Object that can restore {@link ClippingConfiguration} from a {@link Bundle}.

methods.name: public Builder buildUpon()
methods.comment: Returns a {@link Builder} initialized with the values of this instance.
